headline: At least 2 injured as crude bombs explode in 4 Dhaka areas
summary: Blasts were reported in Babubazar, Moghbazar, Rampura, and New Market, with two people injured under the Babubazar flyover.
details: At least two people were injured after a crude bomb exploded under the Babubazar Bridge in Dhaka on Thursday evening.
The injured individuals, identified as Mosharraf Hossain (42) and Abdur Rashid (38), are both from Munshiganj's Louhajang, according to Kotwali Police Station.
Similar explosions were reported in other parts of the capital, including the Moghbazar intersection and the road opposite BTV Bhaban in Rampura.
Another blast occurred in front of Dhaka College in the New Market area late last night.
Police reported that no casualties occurred in the Moghbazar, Rampura, and New Market explosions.
Authorities are continuing to investigate the incidents to determine the exact timing and the number of explosive devices used.
caption:
Multiple crude bomb blasts rock Dhaka, leaving at least two people injured.

At least two people were injured after a crude bomb exploded under the Babubazar Bridge in Dhaka on Thursday evening.

The injured individuals, identified as Mosharraf Hossain (42) and Abdur Rashid (38), are both from Munshiganj's Louhajang, according to Kotwali Police Station.

Similar explosions were reported in other parts of the capital, including the Moghbazar intersection and the road opposite BTV Bhaban in Rampura.

Another blast occurred in front of Dhaka College in the New Market area late last night.

Police reported that no casualties occurred in the Moghbazar, Rampura, and New Market explosions.

Authorities are continuing to investigate the incidents to determine the exact timing and the number of explosive devices used.

headline_marked: Dengue crisis: [[Dengue cases surpass 10,000 in Khulna Division]]
headline: Dengue crisis: Dengue cases surpass 10,000 in Khulna Division
summary: Hospitals are being overwhelmed by the surge in patients as health officials warn of continued risks into October.
details: Dengue cases have crossed the 10,000 mark in the Khulna Division, signaling a severe spike in the viral fever across the region.
Hospital capacities are being pushed to the limit as a massive influx of patients requires urgent medical attention.
In a recent 24-hour window, 747 patients were hospitalized due to dengue, though no deaths were reported during that specific period.
Health experts warn that the risk of dengue transmission remains high as the country moves into October, urging citizens to remain vigilant.
caption:
Over 10,000 dengue cases in Khulna Division alone. Hospitals are reaching their breaking point.

Dengue cases have crossed the 10,000 mark in the Khulna Division, signaling a severe spike in the viral fever across the region.

Hospital capacities are being pushed to the limit as a massive influx of patients requires urgent medical attention.

In a recent 24-hour window, 747 patients were hospitalized due to dengue, though no deaths were reported during that specific period.

Health experts warn that the risk of dengue transmission remains high as the country moves into October, urging citizens to remain vigilant.
